pages.text: The stabilizers must be placed with fourfold symmetry along the Energy Core's axes. If any side is missing, the field may become unstable and allow energy to dissipate. A stabilizer may be no more than 15 blocks from the Energy Core.

pages.name: Tier 1–4 Layout
pages.text: The four stabilizers are each four blocks from the controller and lie on the same horizontal plane. Purple is only a marker for the controller, because the Core is too difficult to draw.

pages.name: Tier 5–8 Structure
pages.text: At tiers 5–8, each stabilizer must expand into a 3×3 plane facing the Core. All four sides require 36 stabilizer blocks in total.
